ideas.title: Deno Fails a Fetch Call with "Requires net access" in a Worker
ideas.description: Deno blocks outbound requests without the right permission flags or allowlist; grant network access for the target host.
ideas.angle: Open with the exact permission error from `fetch()` or a library call. Explain Deno's permission model, why worker and script contexts still need explicit `--allow-net` or deployment-specific permission settings, and how host allowlists affect the request. Include the exact command-line flag and a safer scoped permission example.

ideas.title: Postgres Generates Duplicate IDs After a Manual Import Leaves the Sequence Behind
ideas.description: Postgres inserts collide when an imported table’s sequence is lower than existing rows; reset the sequence to match the data.
ideas.angle: Start with the concrete failure: `duplicate key value violates unique constraint` on an auto-increment column. Explain how `SERIAL` or identity columns depend on a sequence, why bulk imports or manual inserts can leave the sequence behind, and how that creates collisions. Show the SQL to inspect the current value and advance the sequence to `max(id)`.

ideas.title: Dockerfile Builds a Next.js App, Then Node Crashes with "ERR_OSSL_EVP_UNSUPPORTED"
ideas.description: A Docker image with the wrong Node or OpenSSL version can break Next.js builds; align the base image and runtime.
ideas.angle: Open with the build or startup error exactly as it appears inside the container. Explain why Next.js or its transitive dependencies can fail when the image pins an older Node/OpenSSL combo than the lockfile expects. Cover choosing a compatible base image, matching build and runtime stages, and verifying the Node version inside the container.

drafted.title: Vite Dev Server Fails to Start with "Port 5173 is already in use"
drafted.description: Vite stops before serving when another process already binds the default port; free the port or choose a new one safely.
drafted.angle: Begin with the exact startup error and the port number Vite reports. Explain why the dev server probes a default port, how port conflicts happen, and how Vite chooses the next available one when `strictPort` is off. Cover `--port`, `strictPort`, and how to identify the process that owns the port.
